verdict.rationale: The docs show seven built-in ranking rules, including a "sort" rule, and say developers can reorder them to fit their needs. The pricing page advertises Dynamic Search Rules to boost, pin, or bury results per request, plus personalization. However, nothing in the pack shows how to define custom ranking rules on document attributes such as popularity, recency, or margin, so business-signal ranking is only implied. Missing for 10: documented custom attribute-based ranking rules (e.g., popularity/recency/margin fields), detailed docs for Dynamic Search Rules beyond a pricing-page mention, independent or hands-on corroboration.
